title: South Florida weekend plans, Oct. 16 to 18
igCaption:
Las Olas first, then the Halloween events.

Sources: Sun Sentinel, WPEC, Miami New Times, Secret Miami

#MiamiWeekend #FortLauderdale #SouthFlorida #ThingsToDo

scenes.text: Need weekend plans for October sixteenth to eighteenth? Start on Las Olas, then save the Halloween stuff for later.
Las Olas shows up in October event guides in Fort Lauderdale. The Las Olas Art Fair and Las Olas Autumn Festival both land on the calendar this month, centered around East Las Olas Boulevard.
scenes.caption: Las Olas shows up in October event guides in Fort Lauderdale. The Las Olas Art Fair and Las Olas Autumn Festival both land on the calendar this month, centered around E. Las Olas Blvd.

scenes.text: For a Halloween drink stop, Room 901 runs its Carrie takeover through Halloween. It is inside Hyatt Centric Las Olas at 100 E. Las Olas Blvd., with a 1970s prom theme and Prom Punch.

scenes.text: Saturday night goes to the Kimpton Surfcomber on Miami Beach. The hotel hosts a Halloween murder mystery dinner at 8 p.m. Guests get assigned character roles, work clues, and eat a three-course meal with craft cocktails. If you’re there, open NEAR later and see who else solved the mystery.

scenes.text: For families planning ahead, NightGarden opens November 12 at Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden. This year adds an ice rink under the palms, plus a 60-minute walk through illuminated paths and larger-than-life sculptures.
